d: Short, copper-brown hair is styled into two low pigtails with blunt-cut bangs, framing the face of a young child. The wide, cheerful eyes are a reddish-brown shade. A petite build is dressed in a white sailor-style dress with blue trim and a blue collar, accented by a small yellow bow. Accessories include a white sailor cap with a blue band and a brown leather strap crossing the chest to hold a green equipment box, while a grey and red ship hull is carried under one arm.
